name: Shan Mobile
summary: A completely custom web and mobile experience featuring immersive transitions and dynamic routing.
reason: This project required a complete rebuild of the core architecture to support 60fps animations across all devices. We implemented custom dynamic routing to bypass standard browser refresh behavior, delivering an app-like experience on the web.
outcome: A 40% increase in user retention, a dramatically lowered bounce rate, and a truly premium feel that positions the brand as a luxury market leader.
